history.text: Window moved from winter 2026 to February 2027.

facts: 4A Games is developing it and Deep Silver is publishing it.
It launches the same day on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam and Epic).
The date was revealed at a PlayStation State of Play in September 2026.

games.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
games.dev: Crystal Dynamics and Flying Wild Hog
games.about: A full reimagining of Lara Croft's very first adventure, rebuilt for today's consoles.
facts: It's a modern remake of the original Tomb Raider story.
It's built by Crystal Dynamics together with Flying Wild Hog.
It launches on four platforms at once, including Nintendo Switch 2.

games.about: Card game game launching in early 2027.

games.title: Persona 4 Revival
games.about: A full remake of Persona 4 Golden: a murder mystery in the small town of Inaba, mixed with school life and turn-based battles.
facts: It remakes Persona 4 Golden from the ground up.
The story follows a murder mystery in the rural town of Inaba.
PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC get it on 18 February 2027.
The Switch 2 version follows later, on 20 May 2027.

games.title: Fable
games.about: A fresh start for the Fable series. You play a new Hero in the fairy-tale land of Albion, full of humour and choices.
facts: It's a reboot, so you don't need to have played the old Fable games.
Playground Games, the team behind Forza Horizon, is making it.
It comes to PlayStation 5 as well as Xbox and PC.

facts: Team Ninja is making it and Koei Tecmo is publishing it.
It launches on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2 and PC on the same day.
It is on Xbox Game Pass from day one.

games.title: Exodus
games.about: A story-driven sci-fi RPG about travelling between stars, where the years you lose to space travel change the world you come back to.
facts: It's the first game from Archetype Entertainment, a studio of veteran RPG makers.
Space travel bends time, so friends and places age while you're away.
It was first described as an early 2027 game before getting its April date.

games.title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation
games.about: The final part of Square Enix's three-part Final Fantasy VII remake, bringing Cloud's story to its ending.
facts: It completes the remake trilogy that began with Final Fantasy VII Remake and Rebirth.
It launches on Xbox and Switch 2 as well as PS5 and PC.
It's made by Square Enix, the series' original creators.

games.title: God of War: Laufey
games.about: The next main God of War game, and the first to star Faye (also known as Laufey), Kratos' wife and Atreus' mother.
facts: Faye is the main hero for the first time.
It's made by Santa Monica Studio, the team behind every main God of War game.
It moved from February to 20 May 2027.
